law_name: Law No. 09-08 on the Protection of Individuals with regard to the Processing of Personal Data (Law 09-08)
jurisdiction: National Commission for the Control of Personal Data Protection (CNDP)
applies_to: Controllers established in Morocco or using means in Morocco
key_requirements: Prior declaration or CNDP authorization, consent, data subject rights, authorization for transfers to non-adequate countries
retention_period: Art. 3: data kept in identifiable form for no longer than necessary for the purposes for which collected and processed (limited retention principle)
enforcement_authority: National Commission for the Control of Personal Data Protection (CNDP)
penalties_range: Up to MAD 300,000 and/or up to 2 years imprisonment (criminal); CNDP warnings, notices, authorisation withdrawal
exemptions: Personal or household use; national security & defense; crime prevention; journalistic/literary/artistic activities
genetic_data: Sensitive data includes health data including genetic data (article not confirmed); stricter sensitive-data regime applies
notes: Dahir 1-09-15 of 18 Feb 2009; Bulletin Officiel 5714 of 5 Mar 2009; Decree 2-09-165 implements it
